name: DIN Rail Clip Mount
description: 60 x 50 mm adapter plate that clips over a 35 mm TS35 DIN rail: recessed rail channel with retaining lips and two M4 device mounting holes.

steps.instruction: Create the mount plate: 60 mm long (X), 50 mm deep (Y) and 8 mm thick (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0.

transcript.user_prompt: Create the mount plate: 60 mm long (X), 50 mm deep (Y) and 8 mm thick (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0.
transcript.assistant_message: I've created the 60 x 50 x 8 mm mount plate — thick enough to carry the rail channel on its underside.

steps.instruction: Cut the DIN rail channel into the underside: a recess 35.4 mm wide (X, clearance over a 35 mm TS35 rail) and 4 mm deep, running the full depth of the plate in Y, centered in X.

transcript.user_prompt: Cut the DIN rail channel into the underside: a recess 35.4 mm wide (X, clearance over a 35 mm TS35 rail) and 4 mm deep, running the full depth of the plate in Y, centered in X.
transcript.assistant_message: I recessed a 35.4 mm wide, 4 mm deep channel across the underside — a TS35 top-hat rail drops in with 0.4 mm of clearance, leaving a foot on each side.

steps.instruction: Add a retaining lip on each side of the channel: bars 2 mm wide (X), running the full 50 mm depth in Y, 1.5 mm tall from Z=0, attached to the inner face of each foot (bar centres at X = +/-16.7).

transcript.user_prompt: Add a retaining lip on each side of the channel: bars 2 mm wide (X), running the full 50 mm depth in Y, 1.5 mm tall from Z=0, attached to the inner face of each foot (bar centres at X = +/-16.7).
transcript.assistant_message: I added the two retaining lips at the channel mouth — they hook over the rail's return flanges to keep the mount clipped on.

steps.instruction: Drill two M4 clearance holes of radius 2.1 mm through the plate on the X centreline at Y = +/-18.

transcript.user_prompt: Drill two M4 clearance holes of radius 2.1 mm through the plate on the X centreline at Y = +/-18.
transcript.assistant_message: I drilled the two 4.2 mm device mounting holes through the plate — whatever rides on this mount bolts down with M4 screws.

steps.instruction: Chamfer the straight edges of the top face with a 1 mm chamfer.

transcript.user_prompt: Chamfer the straight edges of the top face with a 1 mm chamfer.
transcript.assistant_message: I chamfered the top edges 1 mm all round to break the sharp corners.
